title: Real Estate Coach
description:

We connect people with the experts, programs, and communities they need to land the job, get into the school, or upskill for a world being rewritten by AI. We're seeking an experienced real estate coach to work with students and professionals pursuing careers in real estate. Why Leland ?

• The chance to join a world-class team helping people achieve their career and educational dreams

• Work in a collaborative, high-energy environment where your contributions have a direct impact

• Operate in a fast-paced, AI-native environment

• We don't hire people who merely want to work for a great company; we hire people who want to make a great company

Leland is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds and demographics to apply.

title: OPERATIONS TECHNICIAN III - PUB SEC (WORKS FROM HOME, CO, US)
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Operations Technician III - Federal has an in-depth technical knowledge of network operations to perform circuit and equipment/network restoration. The technician proactively monitors, responds to and resolves network issues and alarms. In the process of network restoration notifies management and program office with risk potential and an impact assessment.

The Main Responsibilities

• Perform circuit and equipment/network restoration, recognize potential jeopardy conditions.

• Management of circuits (T1 - 100Gb, Ethernet & IP), perform testing and activation of new network circuits as well as long-haul, metro and international optical networks.

• Work very closely with Federal government network operation centers (NOC) customers for all demand and scheduled maintenance to conform to customer network management requirements and protocols.

• Analyze network troubles, assess performance data and develop design optimization plans accordingly.

• Interface with fiber vendors, telecom providers and other entities on complex technical matters.

• Participate as a Lead/SME to select customers to participate in regular customer meetings, procedural reviews, audits, and other functions

• Review and interpret electric data processing (EDP) and as-built engineering documentation.

• Coordinate and track return material authorization (RMA) requests, including vendor interface to obtain RMA authorization requests and completion of RMA submittal forms.

• Analyze, test and repair Layer 2/3 network problems. Ensure services conform to customer mandated SLAs for latency, packet loss, jitter, throughput. Ability to test using standard protocols, as well as Iperf and Brix platforms.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Basic Qualifications:

• Minimum of 5+ years’ experience with SONET based, long-haul and metro transport networks, next-generation DWDM wavelength systems, SDH networks with SNCP rings, DCCS cross-connect systems and/or Ethernet, VPLS, IP, MPLS.

• Possess at minimum an Active/Current TS security clearance. TS/SCI is preferred.

• Ability to relate technical issues to management and Government personnel, interfacing in a professional manner with management and customers.

• Flexibility with regard to work levels and shift accommodation is imperative.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Associate degree in Engineering, Electronics, Software, or Networks; or a related technical or vocational education or equivalent experience. Seven or more years applicable work experience Preferred Cisco CCIP, CCDP, CCNP certifications, Juniper or ALU data networking equivalent.

• Strong working knowledge and experience on DWDM Layer 1, Metro Ethernet and IP communications (IPv4, IPv6, routing protocols)

• Technical knowledge and experience on contemporary technologies (e.g. MPLS, TDM, Ethernet, eLAN-eLine, TCP/IP, BGP, QoS, IP, etc).

• Previous experience with broadband and/or narrowband circuit maintenance, testing and restoration, provisioning databases and circuit activations.

• Previous experience with routers, IP protocols, configurations, interfaces is strongly preferred.

title: Strategy & Operations
description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a company building the first national brand in deathcare. These services today are too expensive and too complicated, and the mission is to transform it to truly serve families across the United States in a modern way. Founded from personal experience by experienced entrepreneurs, the company offers transparent pricing and unmatched hospitality, and has secured significant funding to expand.
The company is expanding fast: new markets, new products, and more campaigns running simultaneously than current systems can absorb cleanly. This role exists to build and run the operational layer that makes that scale possible.
The company believes high-agency generalists are how scaling businesses get built. They move between problems and level up.
The company is built with Boulton & Watt, a firm that has started and scaled companies like this before. You'd be joining a business with serious operating depth behind it, and real room to build.
Own and uplevel a core domain
The company is looking for someone who gets energy from taking a chaotic operational problem, building it to run without them, then taking on the next.
With growth, new operational complexity is arriving faster than systems and the team can absorb it. You can jump right in: pick up a hard problem, understand it deeply, build the system around it, and hand it off. Then you move to the next one.
You'll work directly with the leadership team, with real operating authority .
Things you’d work on

•
Within 30 days , own at least one operational domain end-to-end - starting with the go-to-market infrastructure that underpins market expansion. Understand it in detail, not at the summary level.

•
Within six months , build the system around it: metrics, process, tooling, and documentation. Everything the team needs to run it without you.

•
Hand it off in 6-12 months . Move to the next problem - launching new offerings, turning messiness into a system, vertically integrating key functions, and continuing to repeat the process.

•
Drive a measurable, visible improvement in at least one core business metric within a few months. Not an analysis that could drive it - actually move the number.

We're looking for:

•
Generalist. A career that combines a high-intensity analytical foundation (IB, PE, consulting, or founding a company) with hands-on operating experience at a VC-backed startup - where you owned something end-to-end, not advised on it.

•
From zero, build a thing. You can take a chaotic problem from zero: figure out what's actually going on, build the structure around it, and leave it running without you.

•
Hands-on. Not a role to create analysis decks, but getting into the details because tactics and strategy are actually the same thing. You get joy from building a real thing.

•
Commercial. You think naturally in unit economics, margin, and growth. You don't need to be asked to connect operational decisions to business outcomes.

•
Brings the team along. You build with the people who'll run it, not around them. The systems you leave behind make the team stronger, not just the output shinier.

Why join us?

•

title: Applied Risk Standards Specialist
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We believe that achieving our goal requires effective engagement with public policy stakeholders and the broader community impacted by AI. Accordingly, our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the broader AI policymaking community to inform and support our shared work in these domains. We ensure that insights from policymakers inform our work and - in collaboration with our colleagues and external stakeholders - seek to shape policy so that it aligns with and supports our mission.

About the role

OpenAI is looking for an Applied Risk Standards Specialist to lead standards work for applied risk in applications, including mental health, youth safety, age assurance, functional efficacy, reliability, and privacy-related risks. You will help turn internal research, safety policies, and evaluation methods into technically sound, measurable, and adaptable standards that build public trust and support responsible deployment.

This role sits within our AI standards and global assurance function in Global Affairs. Working closely with Safety Systems, Research, Product, Model Policy, Legal, and third-party evaluators, you will author proposals, negotiate requirements, and represent OpenAI in priority standards bodies. You will take on the drafting and external engagement needed to advance this work, enabling technical experts to focus on the underlying methods and evidence. You will also bring emerging requirements back into internal planning before they become established expectations.

Alongside this primary portfolio, you will support the AI Standards and Global Assurance Lead on frontier AI assurance, contributing to risk-management standards, evaluation and benchmarking requirements, and approaches to independent assessment.

The role connects technical practice with external standards. It does not replace the teams responsible for evaluation methods, safety decisions, controls, internal compliance, or implementation. You will own standards drafting, review coordination, negotiation, and assessment-design contributions within an agreed mandate.

In this role, you will

- Lead the development of applied AI risk standards. This includes working with technical and policy teams to define and advance standards for mental health, youth safety, age assurance, efficacy, reliability, and privacy-related risks, with a particular focus on evaluations and assessments.

- Work with technical owners to turn research, internal policies, and evaluation methods into credible test methods, assessment criteria, and standards grounded in real system behavior.

- Bring emerging requirements into internal planning and work with responsible teams to clarify their implications for evaluations, controls, and assurance for our products.

- Work with technical and GRC partners on assessor competence, independence, conflicts of interest, evidence access, reporting, and the distinction between management-system audits and technical evaluations.

- Contribute drafting, representation, and coordination on frontier risk-management and independent-assessment standards.

- Lead assigned standards-body workstreams, negotiate proposals, and coordinate internal input, reducing the external engagement burden on technical experts. Contribute to relevant ISO/IEC, INCITS, NIST consortium, and cross-industry work.

title: Junior Payroll Coordinator
description:
About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.
 
Our Team Culture
We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here - collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
 
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role
Reporting to the Global Payroll Manager, the Junior Payroll Coordinator will assist the team with the end-to-end payroll process.
The Junior Payroll Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting the global payroll department's daily operations. Liaising with our external payroll providers and with the payroll team, this position ensures accurate, compliant, and timely wage processing for all employees. Working under the direct guidance of the Global Payroll Manager, this early career role is ideal for detail-oriented individuals looking to build a career in finance, payroll, or human resources administration.

title: User Acquisition Manager
description:

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

 

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

 

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку User Acquisition Manager.

Які виклики чекають тебе:

- Впливати на розвиток свого напряму та запускати нові точки росту
- Запускати й масштабувати Meta / Google / TikTok / Snapchat / X / Quora та інші канали
- Шукати нестандартні можливості для росту, тестувати growth-hacking підходи й не обмежуватись класичними схемами просування
- Аналізувати ефективність кампаній і дивитися глибше за CTR та CPA - до поведінки юзера по воронці й фінальних бізнес-метрик
- Досліджувати конкурентів: їхні канали, креативи, воронки та підходи до acquisition
- Тісно працювати з creative team: ставити задачі, брати участь у брейнштормах і разом створювати креативи, які конвертять
- Працювати з product & tech командою над user flow, тестувати гіпотези та покращувати performance-воронки

Що для нас важливо:

- 2+ роки досвіду в performance / digital marketing;
- Hands-on досвід запуску та масштабування кампаній у Meta та/або Google Ads;
- Впевнене розуміння performance marketing метрик та їй клюового впливу на продукт та бізнес;
- Data-driven підхід: вміння працювати з великим обсягом даних, знаходити закономірності та перетворювати їх на конкретні рішення

Буде плюсом:
- Досвід роботи з R&D;

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

- Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат - з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше.

- Турбота про щоденний комфорт. Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань в Києві або часткова компенсація занять у Варшаві, медичне страхування, оплачувані відрядження, якщо специфіка ролі передбачає такі поїздки, корпоративні знижки від партнерів.

 

Більше розповімо на нашій зустрічі-знайомстві.

Запрошуємо будувати the next big everything у SKELAR разом!

title: Scientist
description:
Position Summary:

Participate in flow cytometry projects through assay development, validation, and execution in a timely manner.  Perform assays according to SOPs and support development of new procedures and improvement of existing SOPs. May perform other cell based assays.

  Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

• Perform Flow cytometry primarily, as well as, other immune assays

• Design and perform experiments, independently and accurately analyze and present data

• High quality output is essential with the ability to build efficiency into improving productivity metrics

• Assist in establishing and improving all procedures and required SOP documentation

• Responsible for trouble shooting and correcting routine scientific issues/problems

• Identify, update and implement emerging laboratory techniques

• Maintain and support safe lab practices and environment

• Work collaboratively with other technical teams in resource sharing and providing technical expertise

• Support new equipment operational qualifications and performance checks

• Monitor Product and Service/R&D related project expenses

• Act as a scientific resource externally to clients and internally

• Assists with writing, reviewing and editing contract and grant applications/proposals as appropriate.

• Assists with writing and publishing papers, abstracts, techniques/or chapters to maintain the scientific standard and image of the company

• May present completed work at appropriate scientific meetings and in publications

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

• Master’s Degree in life sciences or another relevant field

• 5 years of relevant laboratory experience

Other Required:

• Expert level flow cytometry skills using both whole blood and isolated cells

• Demonstrated skills in monitoring cell-mediated immunity through flow cytometry, as well as, ELISpot, ELISA and MSD

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills required

• Must have the ability to organize and analyze data, as well as, prepare reports

• Must possess strong computational skills, preferably experienced with Word, Excel, Power Point, GraphPad Prism, Diva, and FlowJo

• Excellent use of judgment and discretion required

• Extended work hours may be occasionally necessary in order to meet business demands

• The ability to see and differentiate between colors on the full color spectrum

• Ability to lift and carry between 1-15 lbs.; Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. overhead with assistance; frequently required to sit, grasp, and use right/left finger dexterity; May be exposed to a cold freezer environment (Freezer temperatures range between -20ºC -196ºC)

• Must be able to read, write, speak fluently and comprehend the English language

Preferred:

• A solid understanding of current GLP or CAP/CLIA/ISO standards

• Demonstrated skills with assays used for immunophenotyping such as primary cell based assays, ELISpot, ELISA and Mesoscale

• Experience with cell sorting techniques

Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.

Since being acquired by ClickHouse, with access to ClickHouse's broader GTM resources, Langfuse now has a growing enterprise motion and a large self-hosted user base.

This role exists to give Langfuse a clear, accurate narrative that is easier to understand and adopt.

 

HOW THE ROLE WORKS

This role is for a product marketer who likes technical depth. A technical background is a strong plus, you should be technical enough to use the product, understand the market, earn credibility with engineers, and spot vague or misleading marketing.

You'll become a true power user of Langfuse, and gain a front-row seat into how the best AI teams build production applications.

You should expect close working relationships with both Langfuse teams and ClickHouse’s product marketing, sales and regional GTM teams.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Substantial experience in product marketing, product, or a technical role, including time spent on industry or vertical marketing.

- Past track record of crafting compelling messaging, positioning, and value propositions that resonate with developers, technical buyers, AI teams, enterprise stakeholders, and other highly technical audiences.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and concisely.

- You have a technical background and an analytical mindset with the capacity to leverage data and metrics to measure performance in open-source PLG funnels and inform decision-making.

- Cross-functional collaborator comfortable working with stakeholders across functions and levels.

- A strong plus if you have a background in dev tools, open source, observability, or data/cloud infra. and/or if you have an existing public content or writing presence.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build messaging, positioning, and value props that work for developers, technical buyers, and enterprise stakeholders alike

- Own the category narrative (LLM observability, evals, prompt management, agent observability, self-hosting)

- Create sales enablement and marketing collateral and assets, including website content, blogs, webinars and presentations, launch narratives, and more

- Conduct competitive analysis to understand market trends, identify opportunities, and inform product and marketing strategies

- Evaluate and iterate on strategies with metrics and feedback from stakeholders to track efficacy, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven recommendations

- Lead product and feature launches, and spend time with users, customers, prospects, sales, support, and community members.

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

title: Sr Customer Experience Specialist - Finance
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is looking for a Senior Escalations Program Manager to own our most complex customer escalations and turn those experiences into durable improvements. Approximately 70% of your time will be spent managing complex customer finance requests, you will coordinate cross-functional resources, lead executive-level communications, and drive rapid, high-quality resolution for high-severity customer issues. The remaining 30% of your time will focus on programs that eliminate root causes, streamline workflows, proactively resolve potential customer billing issues and scale customer-facing processes.

This role is ideal for a structured, customer-centered operator who can bring clarity to complex situations, build alignment across teams, and translate individual escalations into systemic improvements.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work will help customers operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We create opportunities to learn, grow, and master your craft in a high-growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: Digitizing large sectors of the global economy requires creative problem-solving, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to customer success.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, support each other, and hold ourselves accountable to high standards.

In this role, you will:

• Own priority customer escalations end to end, including triage, action planning, cross-functional coordination, risk management, and real-time status updates to customers and executive stakeholders.

• Serve as the single-threaded owner for complex escalations, creating structure and accountability across Sales, Finance, Support, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other partner teams.

• Deliver clear post-mortems and executive summaries; track resolution progress, commitments, and follow-up actions through closure.

• Analyze escalation themes and quantify business impact to identify and prioritize opportunities for process, product, and workflow improvement.

• Lead cross-functional programs to improve the customer experience - standardize escalation workflows, service-level expectations, tooling, reporting, and dashboards.

• Coach frontline teams on escalation prevention, de-escalation, customer communication, and effective use of escalation processes.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles-Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team-as we scale globally and across new offices.

• Reduced mean time to resolutio

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - München
description:
Du hast noch nie im Vertrieb gearbeitet, würdest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlangen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei uns lernst du Vertrieb von Grund auf und baust dir dein eigenes Netzwerk in deiner Region auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

•

title: AI Specialist - Enterprise Decision Management
description:
ABOUT CAPCO

Capco, a Wipro company, is a global management and technology consultancy specialising in driving digital transformation across the financial services industry. Operating at the intersection of business and technology, Capco combines innovative thinking with unrivalled industry knowledge to fast-track initiatives for banking and payments, capital markets, wealth and asset management, and insurance. Our ingenuity is brought to life through our Innovation Labs, award-winning Be Yourself at Work culture, and a diverse, talented team across more than 30 offices worldwide.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

Every consequential moment in financial services - approving a policy, extending credit, flagging a transaction, recommending a portfolio - is a decision. The best financial institutions do not leave those decisions to chance, intuition, or inconsistent human judgement. They engineer them: combining predictive analytics, business rules, and optimisation into decision services that are fast, consistent, auditable, and continuously improving. That discipline is Enterprise Decision Management.

As an AI Specialist in Enterprise Decision Management, you will lead the design and delivery of intelligent decision automation solutions for Capco's financial services clients across Asia. You will help clients move beyond point-in-time analytics and disconnected AI engines toward closed-loop decision systems: where predictive models inform rules, rules govern actions, outcomes are measured, and both models and rules are continuously refined as a result.

This role demands genuine depth across the full AI and decision management spectrum - from classical techniques such as expert systems, case-based reasoning, and scorecards, through to modern machine learning, optimisation, and large language model integration. We are not looking for generalists who discovered AI in the last few years. We are looking for practitioners who have spent a career building, deploying, and improving intelligent decision systems in production financial services environments.

Think of this as a forward-deployed role: you will be embedded with clients, building working solutions alongside their teams, and leaving behind capabilities that outlast the engagement. You will also play a defining role in building Capco's Enterprise Decision Management practice across Asia.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Decision Strategy & Architecture

• Lead the design of end-to-end Enterprise Decision Management (EDM) architectures - connecting data ingestion, predictive model scoring, business rule execution, decision optimisation, and outcome measurement into coherent, production-grade decision services.

• Advise clients on decision strategy: identifying which decisions to automate, which to augment, and which to keep in human hands - and designing the governance frameworks to manage each appropriately.

• Model and decompose complex financial services decision domains - underwriting, claims adjudication, credit and affordability assessment, client suitability, fraud detection, and regulatory compliance - into structured decision architectures using DMN and related standards.

• Define the feedback loops and monitoring frameworks that allow decision systems to learn from outcomes - closing the loop between prediction, decision, action, and measurement.

Predictive Analytics & Optimisation

• Design and oversee the development of predictive models - including scorecards, logistic regression, gradient boosting, and neural network approaches - that feed directly into operational decision flows.

• Apply prescriptive analytics and mathematical optimisation techniques (linear programming, constraint optimisation, genetic algorithms) to maximise decision outcomes at portfolio or population level, not just at the individual transaction level.

title: Director, Product Marketing, GTM

Temporal must help them recognize the problem, understand where the product fits, and see why it matters now.

Working directly with the VP of Product Marketing, you will own market-facing Product Marketing. You will decide which customer problems, use cases, audiences, and industries deserve investment. You will own positioning and messaging, turn the strategy into campaigns and activation programs, set direction for solutions and sales plays, and co-own packaging of pricing with the VP. You will work across Demand Generation, Brand, Communications, Sales, and Solutions Architecture, bringing in Product Marketing Engineers when the work requires technical investigation or proof. You will own relationships with SIs.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will write, make investment choices, shape programs, resolve recurring field needs, and advise the VP on GTM tradeoffs. You will manage a Solutions and Value Product Marketer and a Principal Competitive Intelligence Product Marketing Engineer. As the market changes, you will direct the team toward the customer and field problems that matter most.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Set Temporal's market priorities across application and AI use cases, audiences, and selected industries. Decide where the company should focus, what outcome Temporal can credibly own, and what must be true for the investment to work.

- Set the narrative, quality bar, and business priorities for solutions and vertical marketing. Ensure each solution connects technical architecture to developer, platform, operational, and business outcomes, then guide the Solutions and Value Product Marketer in turning those priorities into market programs and sales plays.

- Turn the strategy into GTM plans across the company narrative, web, campaigns, content, events, field programs, and customer activation. Define the role of each channel and keep the story consistent from first exposure through adoption.

- Run a disciplined intake and triage process for Sales and Solutions Architecture. Separate one-off requests from recurring market needs, then decide whether the response is positioning, content, competitive work, technical proof, product feedback, or a combination.

- Co-own pricing and packaging with the VP of Product Marketing, partnering with Product, Finance, Sales, and Developer Success on customer evidence and market implications.

About the opportunity
We’re looking for a driven, commercially sharp Enterprise Business Development Manager to open head office doors with the UK’s multi-site restaurant groups and bring them onto First Table at scale.
This is a newly created, national new-business role. Until now we have signed restaurants one site at a time through our regional BDMs. You’ll change that for groups: selling at head office level under group master agreements covering current and future sites, rather than site by site.
The UK & Ireland is one of our biggest growth bets, with a plan to multiply supply across 22 target cities over the next two years. You’ll have a defined named-account list built from our proprietary market data, the backing of our field sales and Partner Success teams, and the freedom to build a group portfolio from zero.
This is a full-time, permanent role reporting to our GM, UK & Ireland.
About us
At First Table , our vision is simple: to be the first place diners go to book a table.
First Table now offers our great dining experiences at amazing restaurants across the UK. Following the recent city launches in Bournemouth, Leicester, Norwich, and Southampton, we are doubling down on building a strong presence and connected team across the UK.
First Table is a dining discovery platform that connects diners to restaurants through their love of food. Through our clever tech, we help restaurants get their night off to a great start and give diners a compelling reason to try somewhere new. It’s a win-win situation. From early bird offers to last table reservations, we make discovering and booking great dining experiences fast, easy, and rewarding.
At the heart of everything we do are our values: Grow Together, Win-Win-Win, and Own It. These guide how we show up for each other, our restaurant partners, and our diners and they’re a big part of what makes First Table a great place to work.
Learn more about our story here:
About the role
You’ll own new-business sales to the UK’s multi-site restaurant groups. Your named-account list is made up of bookable, premium-casual groups where our model demonstrably works, including brands already live on First Table whose sites outperform the typical independent. Your job is to turn that list into master agreements, and master agreements into live sites, on rollout schedules you negotiate and drive.
This is a hunting role. Once a group’s sites are live, they move to our Partner Success team for account management and you move on to the next deal, re-engaging an existing group only to extend the agreement or sell new sites into it.
If you’re looking for a book to manage, this isn’t that job. If you want to open head office doors and build a group portfolio from zero, it is.
What you’ll be doing

• Own the named-account list: prospect, qualify and prioritise the UK’s dining groups, starting with brands already live on the platform whose numbers make the case for us.

• Sell at head office level, reaching operations directors, commercial directors and founders, and running multi-stakeholder sales cycles of 3 to 6 months.

• Close group master agreements covering current and future sites.

• Negotiate rollout schedules into every agreement and drive them, working with Partner Success on onboarding and local BDMs on launch support, so contracted sites actually go live.

• Build the group proposition: group-level performance reporting, a single point of contact during rollout, and expansion cases built on live site data.

• Run a clean pipeline in HubSpot on group parent records, with honest stage data, so forecasts are trusted.

• Prioritise brands on our live reservation-system integrations, highlight stalled pipeline by reservation partner, and feed head office insights back into our product and partnerships plans.

• Build relationships with key third parties to open doors with target groups, and represent First Table at industry and networking events

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love-driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

ShopMy is growing in Europe, and we’re building the team on the ground. As Senior Associate, Strategic Business Development & Partnerships, you’ll work directly with our European lead to bring ShopMy to the region’s top brands and creators. You’ll own the day-to-day work behind our growth, from brand events and activations to creator outreach and partnership coordination, so we can scale faster across the market.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can take real work off a busy leader’s plate without needing much guidance. You’re highly organized, obsessed with details, and comfortable representing ShopMy in the room with brands and creators. The role is London-based and remote-first: we don’t have a London office yet, so you’ll need to stay motivated and organized without a team around you every day.

What You’ll Do

• Events & Activations: Plan and run ShopMy’s events across Europe from start to finish, including brand partner events, sponsored activations, and our own events like supper clubs and creator dinners. You’ll own vendors, guest lists, RSVPs, invitations, run-of-show and on-site logistics.

• Pipeline & Follow-Through: Track brand and creator conversations, keep records organized, and keep timelines and deliverables on track.

• Research & Insights: Map the European brand and creator landscape: who to prioritize, what’s happening in each market, and where ShopMy can win.

• Operations & Admin: Manage the day-to-day, including scheduling, travel, internal updates and recaps. Build simple systems that help a small team scale.

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with ShopMy’s New York teams across time zones to keep Europe’s priorities aligned with the wider business.

• Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through. When you own something, it gets done.

• Strong project management skills: you can juggle many workstreams, set priorities and move them forward at the same time.

• Experience planning or supporting events, activations or client-facing programs.

• A polished, warm communicator who is comfortable representing ShopMy in person with brands and creators.

• A true self-starter who takes ownership and moves work forward independently in a remote-first setup.

• Motivated by building ShopMy’s presence in the region, not your own personal network.

• Comfortable with ambiguity and a fast pace. Open to occasional evening events, travel across Europe, and calls with our New York

This position is based in our satellite production facility in  Midland, TX .

AST SpaceMobile is seeking an Industrial Maintenance Technician to support the maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, and reliability of production equipment, facility systems, and manufacturing operations within our satellite production facility. This role is responsible for performing preventative maintenance, diagnosing mechanical and electrical issues, repairing equipment, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives to maximize equipment uptime, reliability, and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate possesses strong mechanical aptitude, electrical troubleshooting skills, preventative maintenance experience, and the ability to work safely in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Experience in industrial maintenance, manufacturing, military maintenance, aerospace, electronics, reliability engineering, or industrial operations is highly preferred.

• Assist in developing and improving preventative maintenance programs.

• Utilize multimeters, hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment to identify root causes and restore equipment functionality.

Manufacturing & Production Support

• Support production operations by responding to equipment breakdowns and minimizing downtime.

• Coordinate maintenance activities to maximize equipment availability and operational efficiency.

• Assist with installation, modification, relocation, and commissioning of production equipment.

• Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action activities.

Facility Maintenance

• Maintain building systems including lighting, HVAC, plumbing, compressed air systems, and electrical infrastructure.

• Perform general facility repairs and maintenance activities as needed.

• Maintain safe and efficient facility operations.

Safety & Compliance

• Follow OSHA regulations, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), electrical safety practices, and company safety procedures.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

• Participate in safety audits, inspections, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Ensure all maintenance activities comply with company policies and applicable regulations.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen, Permanent Resident, or authorized to work in the United States.

• Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record.

• High School Diploma or GED.

- You have strong experience, demonstrated through project work or real world experience, leveraging agentic AI capabilities to accelerate security workflows, automate repetitive tasks, or enhance detection and remediation efforts

- You have experience with internal tool development and engineering enablement

- You have a strong foundational understanding of software development principles, and are comfortable reading and writing code

- You work well in a team environment with positive communications amongst a variety of technical and non-technical stakeholders

- You’re adaptable and resilient, thriving in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities

 

Bonus points for:

- Experience with Rust and/or Golang, or a demonstrated ability to pick up new languages quickly.

- Experience conducting security code reviews, design architecture guidance, threat modelling

- Practical or hands-on experience with web application security topics, including but not limited to topics in OWASP

title: Staff / Principal Security Engineer, AI Safety and Security
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila is developing AI systems for scientific discovery, connecting advanced models with scientific tools and automated laboratories. As these systems become more capable, we need to understand how they could be misused or compromised, which protections matter most, and how to establish that those protections work together.

We're hiring an experienced security practitioner to lead this work at the boundary between AI safety and security. You will investigate real systems, develop threat models, test important assumptions and recommend the protections needed for particular capabilities and deployments. Your work will address both dangerous misuse and the protection of sensitive models, data and research.

This is an opportunity to help shape a developing area of AI safety through security practice.
